meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，当你怀疑 Codex 或 LazyCodex 安装有问题时，它会对比最新官方源码检查本地安装，并给出一份每条结论都附证据的健康报告（通过/警告/失败），还会给出修复建议（但只有在你明确要求后才动手改）。
howto.when: 当你要求做健康检查或“看医生”，提到 LazyCodex、Codex 等关键词，或安装/更新/改配置后 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 安装是否健康。
say.note: 会对比最新源码并给出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告。

say.text: 我的 Codex 更新后有点不对劲，诊断看看。
say.note: 会检查版本、配置和插件负载。

say.text: 对比当前安装和最新源码，看看有没有漂移。
say.note: 只报告差异，不会改动你的安装。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you suspect a problem with your Codex or LazyCodex installation, it checks the local install against the latest official sources and produces a health report (PASS/WARN/FAIL) where every verdict cites evidence, plus remediation suggestions (only applied if you explicitly ask).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a health check or 'doctor', mention LazyCodex, Codex, etc., or Codex behaves oddly after an install/update/config change.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex install is healthy.
say_en.note: Compares against latest sources and outputs a verdict report.

say_en.text: My Codex seems off after an update — diagnose it.
say_en.note: Probes version, config, and plugin payload.

say_en.text: Compare my install with the latest source for drift.
say_en.note: Reports differences without modifying your setup.
